# /craft:ci:watch

> **Poll a CI run to completion, then route the next action: merge if green, triage if red**

---

## Synopsis

```bash
/craft:ci:watch [arguments]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | no | — | PR number (#NNN), commit SHA, or run-id to watch (default = current branch's latest run) |
| `repo` | no | — | Repo in OWNER/NAME form (default = Data-Wise/craft) |
| `bg` | no | false | Print a copy-paste background-poll snippet instead of watching inline |
| `json` | no | false | Emit structured JSON (run, conclusion, next_action) instead of the box |
